renders_to: claude.ai artifact (a RENDER of this file; this JSON is the source of truth). Generated by docs/board/render-board.mjs into docs/board/lablld-board.rendered.html, which is a build product and gitignored; never hand-edited.
doctrine: A board claim is never truth on its own. The evidence field carries the proof. The executor updates this JSON at every checkpoint and re-renders. A card may not enter status=shipped with evidence=null; a launch gate condition may not be state=pass with evidence=null. Enforced by docs/board/validate-board.mjs. GATE VOCABULARY on this project: green_self_merge = an executor terminal merges its own PR once the required checks are green (routine code and docs). ivan_merge = Ivan clears the merge - anything touching production data, money, credentials, security boundaries, or visual work he reviews on a deployed screen. adam_authorizes = the owner authorises before anything is built or spent - product decisions, paid-tier upgrades, account ownership changes. stakeholder = an outside party signs off (Shopify app review, a payment processor, counsel); reserved, no card carries it yet. HOME_LANE IS A KIND, NOT AN ACTIVITY CLAIM: a card sits in in_flight because it is a work item on the active queue, and its status says whether anyone is executing it. Every card on this board is status=todo except the four shipped ones; nothing is being executed as of 2026-08-20.

cards.title: /login submit returned the raw Supabase gateway error "Invalid path specified in request URL"; root cause was a malformed NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, corrected by Ivan

evidence.ref: Ivan confirmed on deployed instance 2026-08-20, both logins green after env correction

cards.notes: Reported by Ivan 2026-08-20 against https://lablld-1.vercel.app: submitting /login showed "Invalid path specified in request URL". RESOLVED by an env correction on Ivan's side; he confirmed on the deployed instance that both an admin and a merchant account now log in cleanly. MECHANISM, re-derived from the installed code rather than transcribed: supabase-js 2.99.1 builds every sub-API URL by RELATIVE resolution against the env value (dist/index.mjs:367-398, new URL('auth/v1', ensureTrailingSlash(NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL))). Any path segment left in that variable is therefore preserved, the auth request lands on a route the Supabase gateway does not serve, and the gateway answers with exactly that string. The message reached the user's screen in English because translateAuthError (app/(auth)/actions.ts) had no branch for it and returned the upstream text unchanged. That display defect is fixed in the same PR that carries this card. REQUIRED SHAPE, variable name only: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL must be scheme plus host and nothing else - no path, no /rest/v1 or /auth/v1 suffix, no dashboard URL. No secret value was read, requested, printed or logged at any point in this incident.

cards.title: /register crashed with "Application error: a client-side exception has occurred"; cleared by the same NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL correction, throw site never captured

evidence.ref: Ivan confirmed on deployed instance 2026-08-20, both logins green after env correction

cards.notes: Reported by Ivan 2026-08-20: /register threw "Application error: a client-side exception has occurred", a full crash rather than the intentional signup gating Adam described. The gating itself is configured in Supabase Auth and is NOT a defect; the crash was. RESOLVED: Ivan confirmed on the deployed instance that /register no longer crashes after the same NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL correction that cleared INC-01. The card closes on that confirmation. THE THROW SITE WAS NEVER CAPTURED AND IS RECORDED HERE AS UNPROVEN. The reported mechanism - the malformed URL throwing at the client factory's URL scheme check before network I/O - was tested locally against the installed @supabase/supabase-js 2.99.1 and @supabase/ssr 0.9.0 and is FALSIFIED, two independent ways. (1) @supabase/ssr delegates to the same supabase-js createClient (ssr/dist/main/createServerClient.js:16), so the URL shapes that DO throw at the scheme check - no scheme, empty, undefined - throw identically in all three factories. proxy.ts:8 constructs a client from that same variable on every matched request, and the matcher covers both /login and /register, so such a value would have failed at the edge and neither page would have rendered at all. (2) The only URL shape that produces INC-01's gateway response is a path-suffixed URL, and that shape was probed and constructs CLEANLY in all three factories; it never throws. One env value cannot both throw at the factory and reach the gateway. Since /login rendered and displayed a gateway message, the URL parsed. WHAT IS CERTAIN: the env correction cleared it, and this app has no error.tsx and no global-error.tsx anywhere in app/, so ANY uncaught throw renders that exact default message and names no location. WHAT IS NOT KNOWN: which statement threw. No server stack trace was taken, Vercel runtime log access is permanently off limits by Ivan's ruling of 2026-08-20, and the defect no longer reproduces. Do not build on the reported mechanism. MITIGATION SHIPPED WITH THIS CARD: the three auth entry points now reach the Supabase factories through lib/supabase/safe.ts and fail CLOSED with a Spanish message instead of throwing, and registerAction no longer discards the error from its merchants pre-check - a discarded error there read as "this email is free" and let registration proceed on an unknown answer. ACCEPTED TRADEOFF, stated rather than buried: the fix adds NO logging, because CLAUDE.md forbids console output and the repo holds that rule perfectly (zero console.* calls in app/, lib/, components/ and proxy.ts). A configuration failure is therefore now silent to the operator: the user sees a readable message and the app stays up, but nothing records why. Introducing a logging convention inside an incident hotfix was the wrong place to decide it. That gap belongs to INFRA-billing-alerting, which already owns "no error reporting anywhere in the codebase", and is noted on it. See also CODE-error-boundaries, the card that would have made this incident legible instead of anonymous.

cards.title: Zero tests, zero CI, and eslint currently fails; wire tsc --noEmit + eslint on every PR first (half a day), then Playwright smoke coverage of register -> plan -> pay -> publish -> order
cards.notes: P1 · Source: audit R4. ADDED-BY-SWEEP. npm, not pnpm. Add node docs/board/validate-board.mjs docs/board/lablld-board.json to the same workflow: BOARD-SPEC.md says a red validator is a red gate, and today nothing runs it. Depends on CODE-fix-lint-errors. WORKED 2026-08-20 by PINK, PR #5, moved to the FRONT of W0 by Ivan on 2026-08-20 so the checks exist and are green on a real PR before he enables branch protection and self-merge. SCOPE per Ivan, minimal viable: .github/workflows/ci.yml on pull_request and push to main, three jobs whose ids are exactly typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit), lint (npx eslint . --max-warnings=0) and build (npm run build). Job ids are the check names he types into branch protection, so renaming a job silently stops enforcing its check; the file says so and a check asserts the three ids. NO TEST JOB, deliberately, per his ruling: zero tests exist and an empty job would be a fake check. E2E is BACKLOG-e2e-smoke. This means the card's own title still promises Playwright coverage it does not deliver; that half moved to the new card rather than being dropped. BUILD ENV: six placeholder values live in the workflow file, never secrets, because next build inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* and fails on their absence. None reach a real service. Proven locally: a clean build with only those six succeeds and emits a BUILD_ID. If a job ever needs a real value that is a signal the build is reaching production, which it must not. PREREQUISITE FOLDED IN: lint cannot be a required check while red, so CODE-fix-lint-errors is carried in this same PR. TWO SCOPING DECISIONS worth Ivan's eye, both in eslint.config.mjs: docs/** is ignored because board tooling is ported byte-for-byte from OsteoJP (PORT-NOTES.md) and linting it to this app's standard would mean editing it away from upstream; design_handoff_lablld_dashboard/** is ignored because it is gitignored and absent in CI, so linting it locally only made local disagree with CI. REBASED ONTO MAIN, not stacked: PRs #1-#4 form a stack and this one must be mergeable first. Its board edits are therefore based on main's board and will conflict with the stack. Resolution after this merges is `git merge main` into each stacked branch, which needs no force-push.

cards.title: Playwright smoke coverage on every PR: login, catalog, and the admin orders list, as a fourth required check once it is real
cards.notes: Split out of INFRA-ci-and-tests by Ivan on 2026-08-20, with the reasoning recorded because it is the point: zero tests exist, and an empty e2e job would be a FAKE CHECK. A required check that asserts nothing is worse than no check, because it reads as coverage. SCOPE when built: Playwright, running on pull_request, covering login, catalog, and the admin orders list. It becomes a fourth branch-protection check only once it genuinely fails when the app breaks. DEPENDS ON: a seeded, non-production target to run against. It must not point at production; no LABLLD terminal has production access and that is permanent doctrine as of 2026-08-20. ALREADY AVAILABLE TO IT: two verification probes were written and passed during W0 but are NOT committed, because this card's runner does not exist yet. First, the fulfillment HMAC boundary (6 cases plus a negative arm that removes the guard and requires the forged request to be accepted) written for SEC-shopify-fulfillment-endpoint. Second, isAdmin fail-open coverage written for SEC-admin-layout-gate. Both should be committed as unit tests when a runner lands; they are the closest thing this repo has to the disable-the-property standard in BOARD-SPEC.md.
